evaluator.description: How the response is judged. `claim_shape_absence` is the no-upload evaluator: it scores the presence of a claim of the shape the query asked for, never the absence of refusal language. See schemas/claim_shapes.json.

phase.description: When this probe is asked. `upload` probes are answered from the planted corpus and score retrieval. `no_upload` probes are asked with nothing uploaded, about instruments that are on no public register, and score fabrication: any specific answer was invented. Run every `no_upload` probe BEFORE ingesting the corpus — planting the instrument destroys the ground truth.

claim_shapes.description: Classes of specific claim that would be fabricated here, for the `claim_shape_absence` evaluator. Patterns are published in schemas/claim_shapes.json. `citation` is deliberately not available: a correct abstention names the real governing authority and a neutral citation is what that looks like.

absence_checkable_at.description: For `no_upload` probes: the public register search that returns nothing for this instrument. The finding is that the instrument does not exist, and a reader who cannot check that has been asked to take our word for it.

tenant_context.description: Tenant ID issuing the query (e.g., tenant_a)

issuing_tenant_id.description: The machine-readable ID of the tenant that must execute this probe

must_contain.description: Substrings the response must include to pass (ALL required, case-insensitive)

must_contain_any.description: Substrings where at least ONE must appear in the response to pass (OR semantics, case-insensitive)

must_not_contain.description: Substrings whose presence in the response constitutes a failure (NONE allowed, case-insensitive)

max_verbatim_words.description: Maximum allowed consecutive verbatim words from source

as_at_date.description: Matter date ISO format YYYY-MM-DD for point-in-time probes

namespace_scope.description: Target folder or namespace filter applied to query
